title: Nine Months of Naming
subtitle: 努力坚持 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 努力坚持（做人与做事·努力与坚持）
meta: 主题语境：努力坚持（做人与做事·努力与坚持）　|　核心词汇：challenge　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 challenge 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 my mother was sent to name ① challenge she could not refuse, and she said the naming was the whole of the lesson. The ② challenge, meaning the task and not the effort, was nine months long and was named by whoever came last; challenge, she said, is the only thing in a year that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ challenge in that year had the same shape, and the ④ challenge at the end, meaning the one the coach kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever named properly. Challenge, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ challenge was the whole of the training, meaning the test it carried and not the task. The ⑥ challenge, meaning the test and not any of that, is the only thing in a training that everybody accepts and nobody questions; challenge, he said, is either something you name or the only word that means both a task and a test. She said the test is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ challenge had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the shape. The ⑧ challenge of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine months and eleven years of naming; challenge, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ challenge I remember is the one at the end, which was named in 1973 and is still described as the hardest in the county. A ⑩ challenge, my grandmother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being named; every challenge, she said, is a test that has agreed to look like a task. She said the test was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 挑战（指那件任务本身，与那份努力相对）
C. 固定搭配：name a challenge 说出一项挑战
D. n. 挑战（指那一年里每一项）
E. n. 挑战（指末尾那一项）
F. n. 考验（抽象：它承载的那场检验）
G. n. 那场检验（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The challenge, meaning the task and not the effort
challenge was the whole of the training
the challenge had become a number in a report
The challenge of the whole thing
A challenge, my grandmother said in 1978

answers.why: name a challenge 意为“说出一项挑战”，1953 年母亲被派去说出她无法拒绝的那项挑战。
challenge 意为“挑战、难题”，指那件任务本身而不是那份努力，长九个月，由最后来的人说出。
challenge 指那一年里每一项挑战，每一项都是同样的形状。
challenge 指末尾那一项（教练保留的那一项），是唯一有人认真说出的。
challenge 意为“考验”，抽象指它承载的那场检验，父亲说 challenge 就是那次训练的全部。
challenge 为抽象用法，指那场检验本身，是一次训练里人人都接受、却没人质疑的东西。
challenge 意为“挑战、难题”，到 1968 年这项 challenge 成了报告里的一个数字。
challenge 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九个月和十一年的命名。
challenge 意为“挑战”，我记得的是末尾那一项，1973 年被说出，至今仍被说成全县最难的。
challenge 为抽象总称，祖母说一项挑战是唯一会因为被认真说出而变好的东西。
